gui.open2online.support.message:
Thanks for using the mod - if it came in handy, that genuinely makes me happy.

The mod has always been free and it will stay that way. If you feel like supporting the developer, you can do it with a voluntary donation on Boosty. It will keep working just fine without it :D

Ideas and requests for new features are best posted on GitHub: they have nothing to do with donations, anyone is welcome to suggest something.

Thanks again for playing <3
gui.open2online.firewall.warning: Don't use this if everything is working fine!
gui.open2online.firewall.whenToUse: This should only be used when there are no errors publishing the server, but no one can connect to it. Make sure it's necessary.
gui.open2online.firewall.whatItDoes: When you click on "Recreate Rules" button, the old Minecraft firewall rules will be deleted and new correct ones will be created.
gui.open2online.firewall.requirements: This only works on Windows. Recreating firewall rules requires administrator rights.
gui.open2online.port.invalid: Port must be a whole number between %s and %s
gui.open2online.maxPlayers.invalid: Max players must be a whole number above 0
chat.open2online.error.portOpening: Failed to open port. Try changing it or the library
chat.open2online.error.publishFailed: Unable to host online game. Try changing the port
chat.open2online.error.portInUse: Port %s is already in use. Try changing it
chat.open2online.error.autoAllFailed: Failed to open the port with every library. Try changing the port
chat.open2online.warn.usingLastKnownIP: Showing the last known address, it may be out of date
chat.open2online.warn.routerIPUnknown: The router did not report an external IP, the address may be wrong
chat.open2online.warn.carrierNat: Your provider uses CGNAT - the server is most likely unreachable from outside.
chat.open2online.warn.behindRouter: Your router is itself behind another router - the server is most likely unreachable from outside
chat.open2online.warn.whitelistDisabled: Whitelist is off: anyone can join
chat.open2online.warn.licenseNotRequired: License check is off: anyone can join under any name
chat.open2online.autoStartScheduled: Auto start: the server will open in %s sec. Press ESC to cancel
tooltip.open2online.recreateFirewallRule: This may help if no one can connect to your server.
tooltip.open2online.hideIP: Hides the address from chat, so it cannot be read off a screenshot or a stream.
tooltip.open2online.editWhitelist: Allow only certain players to connect.
tooltip.open2online.autoStart: Automatic server start shortly after you enter a world.
tooltip.open2online.autoStart.delay: How long to wait after entering a world before the server is opened.
tooltip.open2online.licenseRequired:
Verify that joining players own the game.

§cTurning this off lets anyone join under any name.
tooltip.open2online.library:
Port opening library. Auto tries them in turn and remembers what worked.

WeUPnP - UPnP
WaifUPnP - UPnP
PortMapper - UPnP, NAT-PMP, PCP

PortMapper is the slowest one, but the recommended one.
